questions.questionEn: What draws viewers so close to Mantegna's Dead Christ?

options.textEn: A long procession leading into the distance.
An extreme view along the length of the body.
A portrait of the viewer beside the mourners.

questions.hintJa: 身体と鑑賞者の立つ場所の関係を考えよう。
questions.correctExplanationJa: 館は極端な短縮法が見る人を場面の中心へ引き込むと解説する。
questions.incorrectExplanationJa: 奥へ続く行列でも、鑑賞者を画中に描き込む手法でもない。 館は極端な短縮法が見る人を場面の中心へ引き込むと解説する。

sources.title: Lamentation over the Dead Christ
sources.claimJa: 館は極端な短縮法が見る人を場面の中心へ引き込むと解説する。

A2.questionEn: What makes people feel very close to Mantegna's Dead Christ?

options.textEn: A long line of people going far away into the picture.
A very unusual view: we look along the body from its feet.
A picture of the person who is looking, next to the people who are crying.

B2.questionEn: What pulls viewers into such intimate proximity with Mantegna's Dead Christ?

options.textEn: A lengthy procession receding into the distance.
A radically foreshortened view along the length of the body.
A portrait of the onlooker positioned beside the mourners.

questions.questionEn: What did the public show at Brera in 1859 celebrate?

options.textEn: A royal wedding in medieval Milan.
The opening of the opera season.
Progress in the struggle for Italian unity.

questions.hintJa: 画中の衣装が属する時代と、絵を見た人々の時代は違う。
questions.correctExplanationJa: 独立戦争と統一運動の進展を祝う展覧会に《接吻》が出品された。
questions.incorrectExplanationJa: 中世風の衣装は王家の結婚の証拠ではなく、この展覧会もオペラ行事ではない。 独立戦争と統一運動の進展を祝う展覧会に《接吻》が出品された。

sources.title: The Kiss
sources.claimJa: 独立戦争と統一運動の進展を祝う展覧会に《接吻》が出品された。

A2.questionEn: In 1859, Brera had a show for everyone. What did it celebrate?

options.textEn: A royal wedding in Milan in the Middle Ages.
The start of the opera season.
Steps forward in the fight to make Italy one country.

B2.questionEn: What did the 1859 public exhibition at Brera commemorate?

options.textEn: A royal marriage in medieval Milan.
The inauguration of the opera season.
Advances in the campaign for Italian unification.

questions.questionEn: What reading links the clothes in The Kiss with its first public show?

options.textEn: Love between two people also carries a patriotic message.
The couple are singers wearing costumes from an opera.
The lovers are showing the uniform of a single army.

questions.hintJa: 画面の色と、それを見た人の時代を重ねよう。
questions.correctExplanationJa: 館の解説では衣装にイタリアとフランスの旗の色が重なり、当時の人は恋とともに愛国的な意味も受け取った。
questions.incorrectExplanationJa: 衣装を役者の配役や単一の軍の制服と断定する根拠は二資料にない。 館の解説では衣装にイタリアとフランスの旗の色が重なり、当時の人は恋とともに愛国的な意味も受け取った。

sources.title: The Kiss
sources.claimJa: 館の解説では衣装にイタリアとフランスの旗の色が重なり、当時の人は恋とともに愛国的な意味も受け取った。

A2.questionEn: Think about the clothes in The Kiss and the time when people first saw it. What can the painting mean?

options.textEn: The love of two people also has a message of love for their country.
The two people are singers in opera clothes.
The lovers are showing the clothes of one army.

B2.questionEn: Which interpretation ties the costumes in The Kiss to the circumstances of its first public exhibition?

options.textEn: A private love between two people simultaneously conveys a patriotic message.
The couple are performers dressed in operatic costumes.
The lovers are displaying the uniform of a single army.
